blocks.x: A working definition of Agentic Process Automation for the enterprise: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.
Agentic Process Automation exists because the hard part of this work is not the model — it is the measurement, the ownership and the audit trail. That is what this page describes.

blocks.title: Agent fleet orchestration loop — Agentic Process Automation
blocks.note: Every iteration is replayable — the inputs, the policy state and the outputs — which is what turns an agent demo into an auditable system.

blocks.x: Every component in Agentic Process Automation has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Agentic Process Automation capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Duplicated work
One registry, one contract per capability — the second team building the same connector gets introduced to the first.
Runaway loops
Agent loops budgeted and capped — a runaway worker stops at the wallet, not at the incident review.
Agent sprawl
Every agent ships with a scoped task, an owner and a budget — sprawl treated as a design smell, not a growth stage.
